_what: H-B attribution concentration by leave-one-sentence-out ablation, fit split

_registered_prediction.above_0084: <= 0 net -- predicted to FAIL the decisive test
_registered_prediction.secondary_unnormalised: WORSE than the ratio (raw drop scales with sentence count)

harness.description: PRIMARY: max_i(drop_i)/sum_i|drop_i|, rank2 minus rank1. Higher = flip.

verdict._caveat: best tau is chosen on fit, on the same 229 pairs the feature is scored on. A positive net here is a design signal, NEVER a result. It needs a held-out read at a FIXED tau before it is evidence of anything.

harness.description: SECONDARY, unnormalised: max_i(drop_i), rank2 minus rank1. Higher = flip.
